description: CR2032 coin cell holder, SMD (for CR2032 / CR2025 20 mm cells): VBAT (+) and GND (−) terminals; courtyard the holder and the 20 mm cell

datasheet.revision: MYOUNG BS-2032-8 SMT drawing MY-CP-0007 rev A/0 (2017-06-28): PCB layout diagram, top view

package.name: BS-08 CR2032 holder, SMD

landPattern.page: PCB layout diagram (top view): + pad 3.5 x 3.8 mm (R1.3 corners) 14.75 mm right of the cell's centre, − pad 4.3 x 2.8 mm 10.95 mm left of it

package.page: housing 24.10 x 15.70 mm, Ø22.30 arc, 5.30 mm high; cell Ø20

pins.name: VBAT
pins.description: the cell's positive, 3 V (CR2032: 3.0 V nominal, about 225 mAh)

notes: A CR2032 gives 3 V (2.0-3.3 V over its life) and a few mA at most (pulses to about 15 mA): for RTCs, sensors and low-power MCUs, not radios transmitting continuously.
Add reverse-polarity protection only if a cell can be put in backwards (this holder takes it one way). A 100 µF capacitor across VBAT and GND helps radio bursts.
The − contact is the holder's spring, soldered at pad 2: the board needs no pad under the cell.
